basics.name: Haoxiang Xu
basics.headline: Cloud Platform Developer and Applied AI Engineer

sections.title: Profile
paragraphs: Cloud platform developer focused on **LLM agents, retrieval systems, and production AI infrastructure**, with experience delivering systems across enterprise and academic environments.

entries.secondary: Bachelor of Science: Computer Science; GPA: 3.96/4.33

bullets: Re-architected an existing LLM solution into an agent framework using **RAG and function calling** across 30+ related tables.
Added support for long, OR-heavy, and complex filters while improving retrieval precision and latency.
Led delivery of a curriculum analytics dashboard using **React, Flask, MongoDB, Docker, and OpenAI APIs**.
Shipped an LLM-based requirements extraction workflow now used internally by the UBC Provost Office.

sections.title: Additional Highlights
bullets: Built an open-source **Ollama desktop UI** with Electron and a Python backend.
Achieved 16th place in a Kaggle Connect-X competition with a search-based game-playing agent.
Published chest CT tumour classification research with model accuracy above 96%.

rows.label: Languages
rows.content: Python, Java, JavaScript, TypeScript, SQL, Go, Rust

rows.label: Platforms
rows.content: AWS, Docker, NGINX, Kubernetes, RAG, LangChain, TensorFlow, PyTorch, Azure, Google Cloud
